options.content: Riverview City 1500 KLD MBR · sensors and lab forms  ·  thin lines: daily values  ·  light blue dashed: calendar-month average (sensor charts: 30-day average)  ·  shaded bands: warning and limit  ·  red dots: outside the limit

panels.description: Daily average from the sensor (thin line) and 30-day moving average ((light blue dashed)).

targets.query: SELECT mean("202_calc_mbr_tmp") AS "TMP" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" > 1 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)
SELECT moving_average(mean("202_calc_mbr_tmp"), 30) AS "30-day average" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" > 1 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)

panels.title: TMP (mbar) · while permeating

panels.description: Daily median permeability while permeating (thin line) and its 30-day moving average (light blue dashed). The median ignores the spikes when TMP is near zero at the start or end of each permeate cycle. Shown in the PLC unit, LMH/mbar.

targets.query: SELECT median("202_calc_mbr_permeability") AS "Permeability" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" > 1 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)
SELECT moving_average(median("202_calc_mbr_permeability"), 30) AS "30-day average" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" > 1 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)

panels.title: Anaerobic tank ORP (mV)

panels.description: Daily values (thin line), each calendar month's average (thick blue, months with at least 3 values), and values outside the limit (red dots). Limits as dashed lines with shaded bands.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection AS time, CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Aeration Tank') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'MLSS' THEN 'Aeration tank' END AS metric, l.result::numeric AS value FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 191 AND ((lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Aeration Tank') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'MLSS')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now()) SELECT time, metric, value FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection AS time, CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Aeration Tank') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'MLSS' THEN 'Aeration tank' END AS metric, l.result::numeric AS value FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 191 AND ((lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Aeration Tank') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'MLSS')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now()), m AS (SELECT time, value, date_trunc('month', time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS mo FROM s), a AS (SELECT mo, avg(value) AS av, count(*) AS n FROM m GROUP BY mo)
SELECT time, "Monthly average" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.time, a.av AS "Monthly average" FROM m JOIN a ON a.mo = m.mo WHERE a.n >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT a.mo AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', NULL::numeric FROM a WHERE a.mo AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) x ORDER BY time
